result: Current Xenoverse 2-specific evidence supports promotion to verified_current_scope.

mechanics.behavior: Propels the user forward with a pink Ki explosion, dealing about 5% damage to nearby opponents and knocking them away.
mechanics.acquisition: Parallel Quest 92 — Revenge of the Tuffle

acquisition_evidence.pq92_reward: The maintained PQ92 reward transcription lists Maiden Burst as a Basic Reward.
acquisition_evidence.independent_context: An early Steam discussion explicitly distinguishes the PQ92 Evasive Maiden Burst from Pan's separately trained Ultimate Maiden Blast.

source_conflict.notes: A separate general Dragon Ball Wiki page contains an inconsistent Xenoverse 2 acquisition-history statement referring to mentor training. It is not used to override the direct PQ92-specific evidence.
